title: Start With One 20-Second Vacuum Every Morning
hook: If you've never done vacuums before, start with one 20-second set every morning.
body: First thing when you wake up, look in the mirror and do one timed 20-second vacuum. When you're comfortable, build to two sets, then three. Give yourself a minute to rest between sets and take deep belly breaths. Morning is my recommended time because you're fasted, even without doing intermittent fasting.

youtube_description:
If you've never done vacuums before, start with one 20-second set every morning.

You don't have to start with three sets. If you're a beginner, start with one timed 20-second set in the mirror, first thing in the morning. Get comfortable with that, then start doing two sets and work up to three.

Give yourself one minute of rest between sets. Take deep belly breaths during that rest so you recover before the next set. I recommend morning because you're totally fasted, even if you don't do intermittent fasting.
